title: Dispatch bot falsely claims WhatsApp sent when no contact / ambiguous match
description: Root cause: execute() returns no-contact and ambiguous-match as a nil-error STATUS (send did not happen). Run()'s send_whatsapp branch discards that status and keeps the model's pre-written 'Sent to X'. Regression from the duplicate-status fix (564bc19). Fix: send_whatsapp returns empty status on real send (model confirmation stands), truthful status on not-sent (overrides model), 'Send failed' on transport error; add global EVIDENCE rule to dispatchSystemPrompt.
close_reason: Fixed: send_whatsapp now reports the real delivery outcome; truthful status overrides optimistic model text; EVIDENCE rule added to prompt. TDD: 4 new tests + existing send tests green; full suite passes.
